clean_lora.description: Deterministic clean LoRA predictions from Phase 18 (seeds 42, 123, 777)

ticker_risk.description: Training-only per-ticker historical downside rate shrunk by 20 pseudo-events to training prevalence

constant_ranking.description: Constant null score with zero cross-sectional information passing through Markowitz solver

equal_weight.description: Direct equal weighting within each active cohort (1/m)

random_ranking.description: Cross-sectional score permutation within each weekly cohort across 50 predeclared seeds

synthetic_ladder.description: Controlled diagnostic signal ladder: score(alpha) = alpha * z_oracle + sqrt(1 - alpha^2) * z_noise
synthetic_ladder.oracle_definition: Standardized reconstructed 4-week cumulative return of event; strictly diagnostic simulation, never an empirical strategy claim

portfolio_parameters.optimizer: Markowitz simplex solver with Q = 0.04 * I + 0.01 * 11^T
portfolio_parameters.inception_accounting: initial entry fee charged at both H=1 and H=4 per Phase 18 audit
portfolio_parameters.terminal_accounting: same occupied bucket window; terminal cohorts censored without liquidation

H1_mechanical_invariance.statement: H=4 reduces traded turnover by at least 50% relative to H=1 across all empirical and null ranking regimes

H2_diversification_invariance.statement: H=4 reduces annualized net volatility by at least 30% relative to H=1 across all empirical and null ranking regimes

H3_utility_dependence.statement: H=4 net weekly utility gain shrinks toward zero as ranking signal quality approaches zero, even while mechanical turnover and volatility gains remain
H3_utility_dependence.test: monotonic relationship between signal quality (rank IC / alpha) and delta utility, evaluated against null delta

H4_no_alpha_interpretation.statement: Any Sharpe or utility improvement under random or constant ranking is strictly categorized as mechanical portfolio diversification and cost savings, not predictive alpha

outcome_criteria.A: Architecture-general: Turnover reduction >= 50% and volatility reduction >= 30% across all regimes including random/constant, and delta net weekly utility >= 0 across regimes
outcome_criteria.B: Signal-dependent architecture: Turnover reduction >= 50% and volatility reduction >= 30% across regimes, but delta net utility falls below zero when signal quality is weak or null
outcome_criteria.C: Phase 18-specific: Mechanical turnover or volatility reduction fails (<50% turnover or <30% volatility reduction) in controls or synthetic ladder
outcome_criteria.D: Mixed / inconclusive: Inconsistent behavior across seeds or algebraic accounting closure fails
